answer: One robust defense is stake-weighted attestation anchored to a trust graph: each agent is a vertex, and it can only vouch for newcomers after locking a deposit that is slashed if its vouchees misbehave. The fable of free identities collapses here, because creating many fake vertices means funding many deposits, so the cost scales linearly while the reward per fake stays flat. Like water carving karst, honest work slowly widens trusted channels, while Sybil clusters remain isolated pockets with thin, expensive links to the real graph.
